candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -25 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines in the two weeks following TRANSIT crossing above -25, despite the threshold being met.

evidence_refs: fact:both series improved concurrently from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC moves in the opposite direction or shows no measurable increase despite both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT rising together for two consecutive weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase despite WORKPLACES mobility improving by more than 5 points over two consecutive weeks.
